 Job Description: 
    
 Senior Network Certification & Implementation Engineer (Juniper Technologies) 
 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Laboratory Certification and Solution Validation 
 Perform laboratory testing, certification, and validation of Juniper networking solutions and architectures.
 Develop, execute, and document test plans for new hardware, software releases, and customer network designs.
 Configure, troubleshoot, and validate advanced networking features using Junos OS.
 Conduct interoperability and performance testing using industry-standard test equipment.
 Create detailed technical reports, configuration guides, test results, and operational procedures.
 Deliver technical presentations and knowledge transfer sessions to engineering and operations teams.
 
 Network Design and Customer Implementations 
 Design, configure, and deploy customer network solutions utilizing Juniper routing, switching, security, and cloud-managed platforms.
 Support implementation teams and customer deployments across enterprise and service provider environments.
 Develop resilient WAN architectures leveraging Metro Ethernet, Internet, and LTE backup services.
 Provide technical leadership during customer onboarding, migration, and troubleshooting activities.
 Collaborate with AT&T engineering teams and customers to ensure successful solution deployment and operational readiness.
 
 Technical Documentation and Training 
 Produce clear, concise, and comprehensive technical documentation.
 Create deployment guides, implementation standards, engineering procedures, and certification reports.
 Present technical findings, recommendations, and deployment strategies to internal engineering teams and customers.
 
 
 Required Technical Qualifications 
 
 Juniper Networking Expertise 
 Demonstrated knowledge equivalent to JNCIP-level proficiency (certification not required) with hands-on configuration and troubleshooting experience involving Multicast, GRE Tunnels, IPSec VPNs, NAT, BGP, OSPF, IPv6, Class of Service (CoS), Routing Instances, J-Flow, Real-Time, RPM, VRRP, and SNMP
 
 Juniper Platforms 
 SRX, MX, EX and QFX equipment.  The SRXs will mostly be SRX3XX / SRX4XX series, and some larger recently released Mid-Range models.  The MXs are typically: MX204, MX301, MX304, MX240, and MX480.  The EXs and QFXs are typically the smaller fixed configuration models: EX3400, EX4X00, EX4650 and QFX5120. 
 Experience configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting:
 SRX Security Platforms:  SRX300 Series, SRX400 Series, recently released mid-range SRX
 MX Routing Platforms: MX204, MX301, MX304, MX240, MX480
 EX Switching Platforms: EX3400, EX4000 Series, EX4650
 QFX Switching Platforms: QFX5120
 Mist Cloud Management working knowledge of Mist WAN Assurance, Mist Switch Assurance, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operational support of Mist-managed environments.
 Virtualization & Edge Platforms, requires experience with: Juniper NFX250, NFX350, vSRX, Linux administration, KVM virtualization.
 Testing and Monitoring Tools, requires experience using: Spirent TestCenter and PRTG Network Monitor.
 
 
 Required Skills and Competencies 
 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in complex network environments.
 Ability to independently design, build, validate, and deploy networking solutions.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Strong customer-facing consulting and presentation abilities.
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to engineering, operations, and customer audiences.
 Experience working in cross-functional engineering and implementation teams.
 Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 JNCIP, JNCIS, JNCIE, or equivalent Juniper certifications.
 Experience supporting large-scale enterprise and service provider environments.
 Experience with SD-WAN and cloud-managed network architectures.
 Knowledge of carrier-grade WAN services and Metro Ethernet technologies.
 Experience integrating LTE/5G technologies for WAN resiliency and failover.
 
 
 Education & Experience 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
 5+ years of hands-on experience with Juniper routing, switching, and security technologies.
 Proven experience in both laboratory certification/testing and customer-facing network implementations.
 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 
 The ideal candidate is a senior-level networking professional who combines deep Juniper technical expertise with strong communication and customer engagement skills. They are equally comfortable certifying new technologies in a lab environment, creating technical documentation, presenting findings to engineering teams, and deploying complex customer networks in production environments.
 
 
 
 
 What We Can Offer You: 







 Health & Wellbeing 
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
 
 Personal & Professional Development 
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
 
 Unconditional Inclusion 
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
